instance_ids: 0-based normative instance binding; actual order may violate this order
event_order: array of observed instance IDs if unique actual order is confirmed; null otherwise
observed_ids: instances actually detected in the observations; never completed from normative order
onset_intervals: instance ID -> [previous observation index, first observed index]; empty for the scalar-order heads
confirmed_precedence: directed pairs [earlier ID, later ID] supported by observations or explicitly marked as model-predicted
unresolved_order_groups: instances sharing an unresolved onset interval; scalar-order heads use all observed IDs when unknown
recovery: requires_missing_past_observations means future ink alone cannot establish the missing past relation; with history_not_identified it remains a generic request, not proof that past data were physically lost
progress: raw continuous coverage prediction, independently evaluated from geometry_state
observation_confidence: learned observability score, or deterministic Ledger evidence flag; not calibrated answer correctness
pen_lift_evidence: unknown: no visible pen tip in this D0 set
decision: shared deterministic rule D uses class-derived coverage; full action and first-error fields scored separately
scope: T6 candidate H2 interface only; current visual onset and partial-order errors prevent reliable feedback use
